acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a drywall contractor in Pacifica or Daly City, look for companies with a strong local reputation, proper licensing, and insurance. Check their portfolio for examples of similar projects and ask for references. Ensure they offer a clear, written estimate detailing all costs and timelines. Good communication, a commitment to cleanliness, and a warranty on their work are also key indicators of a reliable contractor. City Dweller, LLC operates in these areas and meets these criteria.
